verdict.rationale: All options satisfy coach service and a single connection, while each makes a different tradeoff among Monday departure time, Thursday return time, connection-buffer length, and fare. A is cheapest and has the latest return but the shortest first connection; B is slightly later outbound with modestly better connection time; C and D offer longer connection buffers and later Monday departures at higher fares. The query supplies no priority or minimum connection-time threshold that makes one option clearly dominant.
